label: Weather
description: Official weather integration powered by Open-Meteo public APIs (no API key required).

apps.label: Forecast
apps.description: Public weather data from Open-Meteo (no API key required).

connectPrompt: Connect Weather to use keyless forecast and current-condition tools, then trigger tasks on weather events.

tools.name: weather_search_locations
tools.description: Search Open-Meteo locations by city or place name. When multiple Weather accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which one to use.

tools.name: weather_get_current
tools.description: Get current weather conditions for a location or coordinates. When multiple Weather accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which one to use.

latitude.description: Latitude, required with longitude if location is omitted.

longitude.description: Longitude, required with latitude if location is omitted.

tools.name: weather_get_forecast
tools.description: Get hourly weather forecast for a location or coordinates. When multiple Weather accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which one to use.

latitude.description: Latitude, required with longitude if location is omitted.

longitude.description: Longitude, required with latitude if location is omitted.
